basic_details.job_title: Lucknow University Subject Expert Recruitment 2026 – Walkin

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | subject expert in sociology: P.G in Sociology with UGC/ NET/ Ph.D. or as per University Norms.

salary_details.details: The selected candidates are to be remunerated on a per lecture / hourly basis as per the norms of the University of Lucknow.

selection_process: Candidates will be selected based on a walk-in interview.
how_to_apply: Prepare an application on plain paper with all required details.
Photocopy all academic credentials and self-attest them.
Attend the walk-in interview at University of Lucknow, (Old Campus) Lucknow on 15 October 2026.
Report at the venue at 11:00 AM along with your application and documents.
important_instructions: The engagement of Subject Experts is purely temporary and on lecture / hourly basis. Such engagement shall not confer any right to claim Regular appointment or Permanent Position in the University. Selected candidates would be recruited as Subject Experts for Teaching U.G. & P.G Programme. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the interview. Candidates must bring all original and self-attested copies of their academic credential at the time of interview.
